scope: Full current configuration preparation, source recovery and layer change test review
assessment: Preparation preserves active documents and private staging mode; receipt reuse requires whole plan, inode ownership and Git protection
Complete staged payload resumes after injected sync interruption; partial payload preserved without rewrite
Source edit during preparation refuses prepared receipt
Recovery reconstructs full recipe from owning-layer backup without writes; duplicate authority and substituted backup refuse
Missing new layer authority refuses rather than legacy fallback
Plan binds both documents, presence, inode and mode; changed target/path or Git protection invalidates plan before activation

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=tests:plugins/app-store-creative/scripts python3 -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_configuration_preparation test_configuration_recovery_source test_configuration_layer_changes -q

limitations: Recovery fixtures construct internal journal records rather than execute full public migration
Sync interruption injected rather than actual process termination
Single-filesystem disposable fixtures; real product, browser and cross-volume acceptance remain open
